introHtml: CFS promotional products badge ID holders offer a reliable way to keep employee IDs, access cards, and event credentials visible and secure. Choose from clear vinyl pouches, heavy-duty nylon neck wallets, or full-color printed badges in standard sizes like 3" x 5" and 4" x 6". These holders work with clip-on or lanyard attachments, making them suitable for daily use in offices, warehouses, or trade shows. Customize with your logo or employee details for a professional, uniform look.
